explanation: The Almighty Creator who is the source of all life and rules over heaven and earth.
Jesus, God's Son, who is the visible manifestation of the invisible God and the head of the church.
The concept of being saved from the power and consequences of sin through faith in Jesus Christ.
The community of all believers that makes up Christ's body, regardless of nationality or background.
The act by which God restores the relationship with humanity by removing the separation caused by sin through Jesus' death and resurrection.
The depth of God's plan for the world, fully manifested in Christ, surpassing all human understanding.
God's unlimited strength to govern the universe and achieve victory over all powers through His Son.
